name: Elise Dubois
bio:
Elise's passion for motorsport ignited early, growing up near the Aigle motorsport track. She pursued a degree in Computer Science at EPFL, driven by a desire to merge her technical skills with her love for racing. During her studies, she volunteered with local racing teams, developing software solutions to improve data analysis and communication. 

Elise believes in a proactive approach to IT systems management, focusing on preventative measures to avoid disruptions during crucial race weekends. Her commitment to efficiency and data security has quickly made her a valuable asset to the CRG Racing Team. She is known for her dedication to the team and her ability to explain complex technical issues in simple terms.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elise has a focused and intense gaze, reflecting her dedication to her work.

quirks: Always carries a small Swiss Army knife with a USB drive attached.
Prefers to communicate via encrypted messaging apps, even for casual conversations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
